display.entryTitle: Kiss the Girl Frog Backs Mickeys
display.attractionName: The Little Mermaid: Ariel's Undersea Adventure

description: In the Kiss the Girl scene, look at the backs of the frogs. Each one carries two Hidden Mickeys in its markings.

whereToLook.scene: The Kiss the Girl scene, the frogs
whereToLook.exactSpot: The frogs' backs. Two Mickeys per frog.
